deleted.stem: Which country is not a member of Group of Seven (G-7) countries?
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC: Netherlands, New Zealand and (strictly) Russia are all non-members, so three options are correct.

deleted.stem: The date when the super cyclone hit the Orissa coast which killed nearly 10,000 people and affected over 15 million people across 12 districts of Orissa is
deleted.note: deleted by APPSC. Key from examsnet.com (no official APPSC key document). No option carries 29-10-1999.

deleted.stem: The Lokpal Bill was first introduced in the Lok Sabha in the year
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC: the correct year (1968) is not among the options.

deleted.stem: National Disaster Reserve Fund is the result of
deleted.note: deleted by APPSC. Key from examsnet.com (no official APPSC key document). The fund's name is wrong ('Response' Fund), probably the reason for deletion.

deleted.stem: ISRO launched G-SAT-8 Communication Satellite on
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC: no option gives the actual date 21 May 2011.

deleted.stem: Name the Rana of Mewar who employed Baksariya Muslims in his army :
deleted.note: deleted by APPSC. No key; question deleted.

deleted.stem: Regarding the Article 15 of the Constitution of India, find the wrong answer.
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC; the 'wrong answer' is arguably option 4 (economically vs educationally), but the 103rd Amendment's EWS clause made it ambiguous.

deleted.stem: Due to the existence of which article, the State cannot interfere and dispossess a person's property except in accordance with the procedure established by law ?
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC: the correct provision (Article 300A) is not among the options.

deleted.stem: According to the NSSO 68th round, what is the rate of unemployment in India based on usual status unemployment method?
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC (no option gives the usual-status rate). The first option is not keyed; all four are false on the facts.

deleted.stem: During which period did India have continuous current account surplus ?
deleted.note: deleted by APPSC. APPSC gave no reason; the fact points to 2001-04 (calendar vs financial-year reading may have caused the deletion).

a. Cyclone Ockhi — I. Andhra Pradesh
b. Cyclone Gaja — II. Kerala
c. Cyclone Luban — III. Somalia

deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC: the Gaja-Somalia pair in every code is wrong, so no option is correct.

(i) Washing soda
(ii) Bleaching powder
(iii) Baking soda
(iv) Slaked lime
Codes :
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC: correct set (i), (ii), (iii) not offered.

deleted.stem:
Which of the following is not a feature of MGNREGS ?
I. Guaranteed minimum wage employment
II. Rights-based employment scheme
III. Generation of wage employment in rural areas
IV. Provision of nutriti
deleted.note: deleted by APPSC. No option equals 'IV only'; the code set has no correct answer.

deleted.stem:
Consider the following statements with reference to “International Space Station” :
I. It is a multinational collaborative project between five participating space agencies i.e., NASA (USA), Roscosmos
deleted.note: Deleted by APPSC (initial key II, III and IV). By fact only III and IV are correct – not an option.

conflicts.stem: Free expansion of a system is
conflicts.note: Stored key (expansion to vacuum) used; examsnet's original key (option 1) was wrong per app explanation.

conflicts.stem: Prontosil is a
conflicts.note: Stored key (Pro-drug) used; examsnet's 'synthetic penicillin' is wrong per app explanation.

conflicts.stem: Raja Rammohan Roy founded a new religious society, the Brahma Sabha, later known as the Brahmo Samaj, in the year
conflicts.note: Conflict: the Brahma Sabha was founded on 20 August 1828; 1828 is not offered and the key gives 1829 (the year Sati was abolished). Key kept.

conflicts.stem: The president of Turkey is
conflicts.note: Stored key (Abdullah Gul) is correct for 2008. The app explanation claims examsnet marked 'Ghulam Mushtaq'; no conflict in the stored key.

conflicts.stem: Mosquito repellents contain mainly:
conflicts.note: CONFLICT with fact: calcium dihydrogen phosphate is a fertiliser; mosquito repellents are pyrethroid/DEET based. No option is right; key kept as published (examsnet; no official key).

conflicts.stem: The first Coalition Government formed at the Centre was:
conflicts.note: Conflicts with group1-prelims-2008#90 (keyed 1977 Janata). Many texts call Janata 1977 the first coalition; this key follows the merged-party argument. Key kept.

conflicts.stem: High powered money is also known as:
conflicts.note: Key kept. Unofficial key (examsnet; no APPSC key document). Conflict: high-powered money is reserve money M0 (RBI), not M1; M0 is not among the options. Key kept.

conflicts.stem: Microlytic anaemia is due to the deficiency of:
conflicts.note: CONFLICT: 'microlytic' (microcytic) anaemia is iron deficiency; folacin causes macrocytic anaemia. Probably a misprint; key kept.

conflicts.stem: The landmark programme launched by the Government of India to combat grave economic crisis of early 1980 decade was:
conflicts.note: Key kept. Unofficial key (examsnet; no APPSC key document). Conflict on date: SAP belongs to 1991 (crisis of 1990-91), not the early 1980s; the stem's '1980 decade' is likely loose wording. Key kept.

conflicts.stem: The person who received Padma Bhushan Award for the year 2011 is
conflicts.note: Key kept (Suman Sahai). Conflict: Chanda Kochhar is also on the 2011 Padma Bhushan list, so option 3 is also true; the item is doubtful (app explanation agrees).

conflicts.stem: The first Indian state in which the institution of Lokayukta was constituted in 1971 is
conflicts.note: Conflict with app notes: Maharashtra (Lokayukta and Upa-Lokayuktas Act 1971, in force 25 Oct 1972) is usually credited as first to constitute a Lokayukta, and 1971 matches Maharashtra. Key (Orissa) kept.

conflicts.stem: The tubes used for dialysis and blood transfusion are made of
conflicts.note: CONFLICT: 'polysilicon' is semiconductor silicon; tubing is silicone or PVC (PVC very common). Key kept.

conflicts.stem: What was the percentage of debt outstanding to GSDP of Andhra Pradesh in 2014 – 15 after reorganization of the State of Andhra Pradesh ?
conflicts.note: Key kept. Initial/unverified key (2017 booklet has no key markings; final key not found). Notes say sources differ (CAG ~28.2%; Lok Sabha reply 23.9%).

conflicts.stem: As per the data available in the National Judicial Data Grid in April, 2017, what is the approximate percentage of cases in Indian Courts pending for more than two years ?
conflicts.note: Possible conflict: app notes (NJDG 2017) give ~45% under two years, i.e. ~55% pending more than two years. Key (65%) kept; the figure depends on the snapshot and court level.

conflicts.stem: What is the meaning of competitive sub-federalism in the context of achieving targets on social and developmental goals ?
conflicts.note: Key kept. Initial/unverified key (2017 booklet has no key markings; final key not found). Conflict: app notes define competitive sub-federalism as competition among local bodies/districts (option 4); 'states competing' is competitive federalism. Key kept.

conflicts.stem: Under the GST (Compensation to States) Bill, 2017, the unutilized money in the GST Compensation Fund at the end of five years would be
conflicts.key: Shared equally between the Centre and States with apportionment amongst the States on the basis of the formula prescribed by the Finance Commission for devolution of taxes
conflicts.note: Key kept. Initial/unverified key (2017 booklet has no key markings; final key not found). Conflict: the enacted Act s.10(3) apportions the states' half by their SGST revenue in the last transition year (option 2). Key kept; it may reflect an earlier draft.

conflicts.stem: Out of the following, which parameter is given higher ranking weight by the National Institutional Ranking Framework of MHRD for awarding overall rank to educational institutions ?
conflicts.note: Key kept (Graduation Outcomes). Conflict: NIRF 2017 Overall weights give Research & Professional Practice 0.30 vs Graduation Outcomes 0.20, so option 3 is the factually higher-weighted parameter among the options.

conflicts.stem:
Which of the following statement/s rightly explain/s about tropopause ?
(i) Seasonal variation occurs in the height of tropopause.
(ii) It is the transition zone between troposphere and stratosphere.
conflicts.note: Conflict: statement (i) is factually true (tropopause height varies seasonally and latitudinally); the key (ii)&(iii) is kept, so (i) is marked F per key.

conflicts.stem:
Match the following Coal-based Thermal Power Stations and their States :
List I (Thermal Power Station)   List II (State)
a. Kudgi   I. Chhattisgarh
b. Kahalgaon   II. Karnataka
c. Sipat   III. U.P.
d
conflicts.note: Conflict: keyed option (II IV III I) pairs Sipat-U.P. and Dadri-Chhattisgarh, which is factually wrong; Sipat is in Chhattisgarh and Dadri in U.P., i.e. option 2 (II IV I III) is correct. Key kept as recorded (initial key); c and d marked by fact.

conflicts.stem:
Consider the following statements regarding ExoMars :
I. Its rover will be the first mission to combine the capability to move across the surface and to study Mars at depth.
II. ExoMars is a joint pro
conflicts.note: CONFLICT: initial key 'Both'; final 'Neither'. Statement I matches ESA wording; II was true until 2022. Key kept.

conflicts.stem: With reference to a mega project pertaining to Nuclear Fusion research that is being built in Southern France, International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER), consider the following statement
conflicts.note: CONFLICT: ADITYA is IPR's own tokamak (1989), not part of ITER; statement III is doubtful. Key kept.

conflicts.stem:
Which of the following statements are correct about Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor Development Program (VCICDP) ?
I. It is partly funded by loan from Asian Development Bank (ADB).
II. It is
conflicts.key: Only I, II and IV are correct
conflicts.note: Key kept (I, II, IV). Conflict: ADB's VCIC plan does identify four priority nodes, so III appears true; the key treats it as false.

conflicts.stem:
Which of the following statement/statements is/are correct in relation to the Human Rights Commissions in India ?
I. The role to undertake functions relating to human rights in the Union Territory of
conflicts.note: Initial key only. Conflict: statement I matches PHRA s.21(6) as amended in 2019 (Centre may confer UT functions, except Delhi, on an SHRC; Ladakh is such a UT). Key 'None' kept.

time_sensitive.stem: Which Article of the Indian Constitution accords special status to Jammu and Kashmir?
time_sensitive.note: Time-sensitive: true in 2008; since August 2019 Article 370 is inoperative and J&K is a Union Territory.

time_sensitive.stem: Which of the following states has the highest number of seats in the Rajya Sabha?
time_sensitive.note: Time-sensitive: after the AP Reorganisation Act 2014, AP has 11 seats, so today West Bengal (16) would rank highest among these options.

time_sensitive.stem: In India, the Inflation measure is
time_sensitive.note: Key kept. Unofficial key (examsnet; no APPSC key document). Time-sensitive: today the answer would be CPI (Combined).

time_sensitive.stem: In India, the proportion of population in the working age group (15 - 64 years) is
time_sensitive.note: Figure is time-sensitive (pre-2008 data); current share is ~65-67%. Kept.

time_sensitive.stem: Which one of the following parties in the Congress-led UPA Government is the second largest party in the UPA coalition?
time_sensitive.note: Time-sensitive (2004-09). The Left parties (CPI-M 43) supported UPA-I from outside, so they are not counted as UPA members.

time_sensitive.stem: What percentage of population possess some form of insurance coverage in India?
time_sensitive.note: Key kept. Unofficial key (examsnet; no APPSC key document). Figure not verifiable from an authoritative source here; time-sensitive (c. 2008).

time_sensitive.stem: The biggest taxation source of the Government of India is
time_sensitive.note: Key kept. Unofficial key (examsnet; no APPSC key document). Time-sensitive: true for c. 2007-08.

time_sensitive.stem: The Sakshara Bharat Scheme introduced by Government of India will be in operation upto:
time_sensitive.note: Key kept. Unofficial key (examsnet; no APPSC key document). Time-sensitive: later extended to 31 March 2018.

time_sensitive.stem: The first set of Identity Numbers as per the Unique Identification Authority of India will be issued in :
time_sensitive.note: Key kept. It reflects the planned schedule as of the exam (5 Sep 2010); in fact the first Aadhaar was issued on 29 Sep 2010 (UIDAI).

time_sensitive.stem: Chandrayan II is designed jointly by India and
time_sensitive.note: Time-sensitive: true as of the 2010 exam; Russia withdrew and the 2019 mission was fully indigenous.

time_sensitive.stem: The election expenditure limit for a parliamentary constituency in major states now stands at
time_sensitive.note: Time-sensitive: 'now' = 2012. Current (2022) ceiling is Rs 95 lakh.

time_sensitive.stem: Rameshwar Thakur is the Governor of
time_sensitive.note: Key kept. On the exam date (27 May 2012) Thakur was no longer Governor (Ram Naresh Yadav took over MP on 8 Sept 2011); the question was evidently set earlier.

time_sensitive.stem: Presently, as laid in the Fourth Schedule to the Constitution of India, the allocation of seats in Rajya Sabha to be filled by the representatives of Andhra Pradesh State is
time_sensitive.note: Time-sensitive: 'presently' meant 2012; today AP has 11 seats.

time_sensitive.stem: What is the all India participation rate of Women in MNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Agency) Scheme in 2016 – 17 ?
time_sensitive.note: Key kept. Initial/unverified key (2017 booklet has no key markings; final key not found). Time-sensitive (2016-17).

time_sensitive.stem: How many Municipal Corporations are there in Andhra Pradesh ?
time_sensitive.note: Time-sensitive: figure as of 2019; AP later had 17 Municipal Corporations.
